owner_authority: Owner requests another research recurrence with broader exploration and empirical work between toy/theory probes and a full algorithm pass/reject task; four-hour total floor.
allocation_note: The 240-active-minute total and default60-minute written-mathematics floor bind; other allocations are flexible to follow evidence. Initial administration, passive waits and closeout do not count. Overlap counted once.
scope: Broaden across native compression/projection, compatible homogeneous state, conditional or observable-law closure, computational realization and a cheap trajectory-matched correction reserve. Begin with a bounded NFC approximation diagnosis; do not let it consume the whole recurrence. Distinct routes are prioritized by information and possible retained score gain, not by readiness alone.
empirical_changes: Use integrated or near-integrated probes earlier; give promising directions a small multi-network pilot and at least one hypothesis-driven stress/transfer check when informative. Do not nominate a compounded untested design merely from one-state geometry if an affordable pilot is possible. Usually1–2 networks for triage and4–6 for promising mechanisms; no compulsory sample quota, archive qualification or formal90-percent gate during research. Keep the final forecasts honest even if no stronger candidate emerges.
data_role: Public/reused development data, repeatedly exposed and usable adaptively. Preserve historical freezes and final blind. Any small targeted fit must record train/evaluation roles; no expanding corpus or training campaign.
initial_compute_plan: Plan approximately40–48 full-shape call equivalents across the round, with saved-state/generated probes. Reassess cumulative cost and learning around24 calls; this is an allocation estimate, not a required quota or a hard micro-probe limit.
